title: Ukrainian drone operators strike Crimea from wheat fields
subhead: The 'Magyar Birds' brigade is at the heart of Kyiv's summer offensive targeting Russian-occupied Crimea. Its young, laid-back drone operators launch remotely piloted aircraft at night, far from the front lines, controlling the missions from computer screens.

title: Searching for Ingmar Bergman's soul on Sweden's Fårö island
subhead: Captivated by the stark beauty of its landscapes, Bergman lived on the small Baltic island and filmed several of his movies there until his death in 2007. Starting at age 60, he also gathered his nine children – born to six different women – at his home on the island. Today, they continue to honor his memory there.

title: 'Magyar,' the man leading Ukraine's drone war: 'Drones are the Black Death of the third millennium'

This summer, he is leading 'Operation Crimea' and continuing his strikes on refineries deep inside Russia.

title: Bernard Arnault's succession, the elephant in the room at LVMH
